name: Microsoft Agent Skills
summary: Microsoft's official Agent Skills catalog for Azure SDKs and AI Foundry, plus plugins, custom agents and MCP configs. MIT; a different repo from microsoft/azure-skills.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Microsoft). This is github.com/microsoft/skills (MIT, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation, not archived), distinct from the already-listed azure-skills entry at github.com/microsoft/azure-skills. The README is marked Work in Progress and says more skills are being added. It is internally inconsistent on catalog size: the What's Inside table says 174 Skills, while the Skill Catalog heading and the Skill Explorer line on https://microsoft.github.io/skills/ (HTTP 200) say 175 skills. That count is not resolved here. Documented install is `npx skills add microsoft/skills` (interactive picker; not run). The README also documents a manual git clone and copying selected skill directories, and warns to install skills selectively because loading all of them causes context rot. Besides skills, the repo ships installable plugins, custom agents, an AGENTS.md template, and pre-configured MCP server configs for docs, GitHub and browser automation. Browser-automation MCP configs can drive a browser; those configs were not installed or called. This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. The pack is free to install; using the skills against an Azure or Foundry subscription is billed by Microsoft and was not re-verified here. No signup or spend.
